as_told.title: Carter holds the Grill Flame file; Harley Trent's 'road' was a river

plain: In the 1970s, a psychic named Rosemary Smith is said to have helped find a downed Tu-22, a Soviet-built military plane, in Zaire. She did it by remote viewing: trying to see faraway places using only the mind. Michels tells it twice. He says former President Jimmy Carter went on record, which he dates to 1976, calling it the craziest thing he experienced as president. In one telling Michels adds that Smith was given "all of Africa" as her target. The remote viewer Joe McMoneagle also tells it, second hand, from what he says happened when Carter spoke about it. McMoneagle says Carter was holding the team's file as he spoke, "a green file with a red stripe" marked Grill Flame, the name of the government's psychic spying effort. He adds that a "road" described by another viewer, Harley Trent, was really a river. If true, the story would mean a US president credited psychics with a real intelligence success.
